description: We made a game. It's got a chat app. It's got multiplayer (hopefully). It's kind of cool.
summary:
We made a game. It's got a chat app. It's kind of cool.

Cubine-1 is a simple 2D game with an optional inbuilt chat app. 

For multiplayer, you'll need to run the server as well as the demo and change HOST to your IP on both files.
details:
Controls:

WASD=movement

Q/E=switch face

Arrows=set power usage

Space Bar=Activate Laser

X=Transfer Data

Demo Extra Controls:

/=Normal Ending

.=Rare Ending
